description: Finding IDs and their descriptions: the vocabulary for grouping failures of the openaero lane (tests/test_openaero_strict.py) in tools/openaero/propose_findings.py. No test reads this file. The findings follow docs/investigations/olan-openaero-differential-2026-11-25 in the FCScoreFuture workspace.

findings.F1: oa_base misses OpenAero's long-forward step ('+' becomes '~~~' before the base is found, parseSequence). A turn written with '+' line extensions has no base, the direction state does not turn, and every later figure's direction follows it.
findings.F2: A roll-only figure with an attitude marker ('24-', '-1-', '-,2', '2f-') is taken for a drawing command and dropped.
findings.F3: A figure's written entry attitude disagrees with the previous figure's exit (mostly free knowns). OpenAero takes the written attitude (an implied half roll, same physical heading); parse_olan chains the template from the previous exit, so it and the figures after it are built inverted. D2: see C4.
findings.F4: For a 90 or 270 degree turn, option 0 of turn_options was not the direction OpenAero draws, and the next figure is chained from option 0. Fixed in C5 for turns with options; a rolling turn with alternating rolls (jio, joi) has no roll_option, so its one direction can still be the other way.
findings.F5: Silent failure paths: parse_olan stops at the first error and keeps the figures so far, OlanRoll.parse stops at the first unreadable piece, unknown tokens become drawing commands.
findings.F6: A ';' or ',' with no roll after it (before the figure letters, '>' or the end) adds a phantom full roll (OlanRoll.parse, new_rolls = [1]).
findings.F7: A spin with turns and no figure ('6s', '5s', '+5s', '6s-') is OpenAero's iv downline with a spin; PyOlan builds a horizontal roll.
findings.F8: Loop signs in inverted variants and after stall turns are not OpenAero's (loop_amounts): pp/ipp, qo, hd/dhd, kz, vv, bh, hp, k, dq, qq.
findings.F9: The figure does not change when OpenAero picks another catalogue variant for the attitude marker or the rolls: 'd-' (1.1.4), 'd' or 'z' with a half roll (1.1.5, 1.1.11: the reversing variant), 'z-'.
findings.F10: The OLAN omits a roll the figure needs; OpenAero inserts a correction roll and PyOlan builds geometry that contradicts its exit attitude (D1). Fixed in C8: PyOlan inserts the same roll and warns; what remains is listed under the figure's other finding (F8, F11, F22, F23).
findings.F11: Joined figures lose the rolls between their parts or get the wrong loop total: mm, oo, ooo and the reversing loops ao, iao, rao, ro, or.
findings.F12: Non-Aresti 0.x figures and PyOlan's legacy compound codes are not the figure OpenAero has under those letters (oj, jw, tri, itri, co, dz, dvz, dvd, rqq ...). D3: match oj and jw, raise for the rest (deferred). parse_olan raises for the inverted variants PyOlan has no figure for (itri, ixm, ivv, ihat, idz, idvz, idvd, irqq).
findings.F13: K differs from OpenAero's sum of base and roll K, or PyOlan cannot compute it (ValueError, and 10 in create_maninfo). Glider K reads the catalogue's 0 ('same as powered') literally.
findings.F17: Rolling-turn roll digits are read as a decimal number: OpenAero reads each digit as rolls ('15' a roll then a half roll, '5' a half roll, '51' a half roll then a roll), with 'io' alternating every roll. PyOlan builds '15' as 1.5 rolls plus another half, '5' as five rolls and '51' as 5.1 rolls, and does not alternate the half roll.
findings.F19: PyOlan builds a figure that OpenAero rejects: there is no catalogue figure with the written entry and exit attitudes (e.g. '3jio15' written with an upright exit).
findings.F20: Quoted comments: PyOlan splits the text on spaces, so a comment with a space becomes tokens whose letters are read as figures; a comment inside a figure drops the roll before it.
findings.F21: A line with no roll (OpenAero's '--', and '-', which OpenAero builds with a correction half roll) is not a figure PyOlan can build: a figure must have an element. parse_olan raises for it.
findings.F22: A half roll at the top of a loop (o- and o(2), OpenAero's 7.4.2): OpenAero draws two half loops with the roll on a line between them, PyOlan one loop with the roll embedded at the apex. The same flight in two forms the canonical form tells apart.
findings.F23: A leading ',' reverses the first roll in OpenAero; PyOlan ignores it. Relative directions are unchanged, so it shows only where a correction roll is added after it (',24'). Changing it changes the roll sign of many figures: left for the user.
findings.F24: A spin with a quarter turn over and no figure ('+5s': the iv downline with 1 1/4 turns) exits across the box; its spin direction is fixed (it has no roll_option), and can be the other way from OpenAero's, as for F4.
findings.OA: OpenAero itself looks wrong here; recorded, not patched.
